divisionTypes.name: Infantry
divisionTypes.description: Infantry divisions are the foot soldiers of your army, and often will make up the bulk of an army’s fighting force. They provide buffs to an army’s melee attackers, making them quite strong when unchallenged in a zone.

divisionTypes.name: Cavalry
divisionTypes.description: Cavalry divisions are made up of mounted soldiers, ideal for extra mobility or extra damage.

divisionTypes.name: Projectile
divisionTypes.description: Projectile divisions can attack enemy divisions at a distance, preventing Counterstrikes from an enemy division so long as they are not also the Projectile type.

divisionTypes.name: Flying
divisionTypes.description: Flying divisions are swift and agile in the air, but vulnerable to arrows and projectile weapons. Projectile Type divisions gain -1 Difficulty on attacks against Flying Type divisions.

divisionTypes.name: Magick
divisionTypes.description: Magick divisions deal punishing blows to enemy divisions at range, while being more vulnerable to physical attacks.

divisionTypes.name: Support
divisionTypes.description: Support divisions grant bonuses not only to the army’s officers, but also to the army itself.

divisionTypes.name: Siege
divisionTypes.description: Siege divisions excel at bringing down Structures. You may only attack Structures with Siege Type divisions.

buffStacking: Officers may only benefit from two of the same buff at any given time. (E.g. an officer may not benefit from two light footmen’s buff or from one light footmen and one heavy footmen, as they provide To Arms).
